n: Duplicate shows an iOS-style banner “Duplicated … · Undo” for 5 seconds
Colour combos retuned to Apple system colours (Blue, Indigo, Purple, Pink, Red, Orange, Green, Mint, Teal, Cyan, Brown) with matching light and dark variants; Coral and Berry became Teal and Rose
Appearance: True black surface for dark mode (OLED), text size (Small / Default / Large), corner style (Soft / Sharp), plain or animated background, and a reset-to-defaults button
Repeating tasks: set Every day / weekday / week / month in New and Edit task; when you finish one, the next is scheduled automatically (once)
Duplicate task button on list and board cards
Eight new colour combos (Lavender, Rose, Mint, Citrus, Coral, Sky, Berry, Midnight) plus Auto, which follows the time of day
Liquid glass refinements: stronger refraction on header and tab bar, glossy accent buttons with a light sweep, richer colour swatches, smooth colour fade when switching

Smoothness pass: scroll position is kept after every change, search waits until you pause typing, softer spring transitions on cards, progress bars, pills and buttons, animated dialogs, no stuck hover on touch screens
Assign one task to several people: pick any number of members (first is the Owner) in New task and Edit task; stacked avatars and a people badge on list and board cards

Shared tasks count for every assignee in member stats, filters, leader view, notifications and reports; export/import accepts several names in the Member column (comma separated); removing a member keeps tasks shared with others
Smoother picker: chips toggle in place with a spring animation, no re-render or jump, 44px tap targets, keyboard accessible

Command header redesign: live greeting and clock, week context (ISO week, relative), office-day progress bar, live task pulse (open / due today / overdue), profile avatar, compact sticky mode on scroll, responsive mobile layout

Insights: new report header (organisation, classification, prepared by), executive summary with delivery-health ring, targets scorecard, auto key findings and recommended actions, print/PDF header and footer
Settings rebuilt as a sectioned workspace: search, unsaved-changes bar with validation, per-section reset, settings export / import, live previews
New settings: organisation, prepared by, classification, opening page, hours format, default analysis period, at-risk window, attention look-ahead, backup reminder, reduce motion
Fix: Insights tags could leak into saved settings
Copyright and licence now name Muhammad Umer Faheem
Insights reporting uses line and bar charts only: member performance (bars + deadline line), estimated vs actual hours (bars), progress trend by member (lines), delivery health (bar)
iOS-style colour-graded liquid glass: accent-tinted background, specular rims, clearer status tiles in light and dark
Tasks filters: high-contrast themed toolbar, new Due filter, Export view (CSV)
Updates no longer create or offer restore points
One Admin only: Team Lead / Viewer roles and the permission matrix are removed; older workspaces are converted automatically (first Admin kept, everyone else becomes Member)
Members > Admin & leader: transfer Admin and pick the weekly leader from your members; the 'Acting as' selector is gone
Tasks filters rebuilt as a theme-aware toolbar: search, member, status, priority, sort, active-filter count, one-click reset and a 'Showing X of Y' line
Theme polish: accent colour, focus rings and selection colour follow light / dark
Insights rebuilt with crisp SVG charts: daily activity bars with gridlines, today highlight and average line; status donut; smooth 6-week trend with area fill
KPI cards now show change vs last week and a 6-week sparkline
Insights sections: Overview, Team, Modules, Executive (remembered); print still includes everything
Hover/tap tooltips on every chart, richer workload view with overdue share and rebalancing hint, friendly empty states
Fixed: board styles had clashed with the Insights bar charts (shared class names)
Board rebuilt: compact cards with priority, module, assignee, relative due date (Due today, 2d overdue), progress slider, timer, estimate
One-tap actions on cards (Start, Mark done, Reopen) plus drag & drop; board keeps its scroll position after changes
Status tiles now focus a column instead of emptying the others; clearer empty states and drop targets
Edge blur rebuilt as a true progressive blur (iOS style): fixed the blur not rendering, smoother fade, lower CPU use
Tab bar fixed: locked to the bottom centre again (v9 styling had pushed it out of place)
Header stays pinned at the top while scrolling
New top and bottom edge blur that fades in as you scroll, stronger while moving
Tab bar stays steady during page transitions
Task status summary: To do / In progress / Done / Overdue tiles with a weekly completion bar; tap a tile to filter
New Board view: To do, In progress and Done columns with counts, overdue and on-time/late markers
Drag a card between columns to change its status (timer, progress and activity log update as before)
Clearer empty states and a one-tap Show all when a filter has no matches
iOS 26 Liquid Glass: refractive edge rims, specular highlights, deeper blur and saturation on header, tab bar and cards
Smooth page transitions (View Transitions), spring press feedback on every control, faster long lists
Typography: SF Pro / Inter with tabular numbers, balanced headings, no long-name overflow
Glitch fixes: layout shift from scrollbar, 16px inputs (no iPhone zoom), safe-area spacing, 44px tap targets, keyboard focus rings, reduced-transparency and high-contrast support
System health panel: storage, data integrity checks, backups and one-tap restore points
Daily automatic backup (last 5 restore points kept)
iOS-style notification banners, launch splash, offline/online alerts
Keyboard shortcuts sheet (press ?)

Team cards: fixed clipped avatar/badge overflow, rebuilt the leader switch, rank shown inline, quieter empty states (– instead of 0%), dimmed zero stats, tooltips for long names, refined leader card tiles
Colour combos: Ocean, Aurora, Sunset, Forest, Graphite with an animated colour-mesh background
Liquid-glass upgrade: edge bevel highlights, cursor-following shine, adjustable glass intensity (Soft / Standard / Strong)
Update history timeline with install dates; Update available pill in the header
Safer updates: verification step, failure screen, automatic recovery offer after a faulty session, background update checks
Team cards rebuilt from scratch: progress-ring avatar, large completion figure, status bar and stat tiles
Module manager in Settings: create, edit, rename, recolour, focus and delete modules with live task counts
Quick plus button beside the module selector for instant module creation
Team cards redesigned: transparent glass with member-colour tint, glow and refined stats
iOS design system: SF-style typography, system colours, large titles, switches and sheets
Glitch fixes: no re-render flicker, lighter blur for smoother scrolling, no input zoom on iPhone
Smoother spring animations on page change and dialogs
iOS-style Software Update sheet with progress and What's New
Smoother spring animations
Stronger liquid-glass UI and smoother animations
One-click Update with automatic safety backup and rollback
Version history and restore points
Modules, module reporting, live GitHub sync
